meaning:
People descended from Shulam(?), first mentioned at Sng.6.13
§ Shulamite = "the perfect" or "the peaceful"
the heroine lover of the Song of Songs (of Solomon)

elsewhere.note: Return, return, Shulammite! Return, return, that we may gaze at you. Why do you desire to gaze at the Shulammite, as at the dance of Mahanaim?
